Main Execution (scripts.main)

This page details the main execution file of the GHE Screen program

Functions

scripts.main.aggregate_metadata(df)

This function aggregates descriptive metadata about the queried areas

Parameters:

df (GeoDataframe): The Dataframe that holds all of the information about queried OSM data

Returns:

metadata (dict): Dictionary containing all descriptive metadata

scripts.main.export_results(df, response)

Exports all of the necessary information to the exports folder

Parameters:

df (Geopandas Dataframe) response (dict): The Overpass API JSON response body

scripts.main.main(args)

Executes the main functionality of the program

Parameters:

args (list[Str]): The arguments to the program

scripts.main.run(args)

This function is responsible for executing the entire end to end flow of the program and all of the internal functions that handle each step of the API calling, parsing, exportation process

Parameters:

args (list[Str]): The arguments to the program
